issues.claim: Frigate row pricing: "Free (open source); optional Frigate+ model subscription - the page shows a $5 charge for each additional fine-tune beyond the 12 included but does not print the annual subscription price"
issues.problem: The source_url attached to that row (https://docs.frigate.video/configuration/zones/) contains no pricing at all - I fetched it and searched: no 'Frigate+', no '$5'. The fact itself is correct, but it lives on the Frigate+ page, which the brief cites separately under models_and_tools. Row-level attribution is wrong, so anyone checking that row against its own link will think the price is unsupported.
issues.fix: Change the source_url on the Frigate entry in existing_solutions to https://frigate.video/plus/ (or add it as a second URL), keeping the zones URL for the zone-inertia/required-zone description.

issues.claim: Prospecting signal: "Middlesex County / municipal retail food inspection reports (public; establishments must keep the most recent report on site and local health authorities make records available)"
issues.problem: The regulatory requirement is stated as fact with no citation anywhere in the brief. It happens to be true (N.J.A.C. 8:24-8.13 requires the most recent inspection report to be kept on the premises and made available for public review, retained at least two years; N.J.A.C. 8:24-8.12 covers placard posting), but as written it is an uncited legal claim in a document that is otherwise scrupulous about sourcing law.
issues.fix: Cite N.J.A.C. 8:24-8.13 (and 8:24-8.12 for the placard) or drop the 'must keep ... on site' clause and leave only the observational signal.

issues.claim: GC 23-02 entry: "The memo text does not discuss union status; that it reached non-union workplaces is an inference from Section 7's scope"
issues.problem: Loose characterization. The memo does reference union representation (e.g. the Section 8(a)(5) bargaining/information paragraph and 'union supporters'), so 'does not discuss union status' overstates. The substantive point - that the memo nowhere states it applies to non-union workplaces and that this is inferred from Section 7's scope - holds.
issues.fix: Reword to: 'the memo does not limit its guidance to unionized workplaces and does not address union status directly; that it reaches non-union workplaces is an inference from Section 7's scope.'

issues.problem: The slip opinion I opened (A-37/81-18, decided June 16, 2020) confirms the docket, date, holding and disposition but does not print the 242 N.J. 449 reporter citation. The citation is almost certainly right; it is simply not verified from the document cited.
issues.fix: No change needed for substance; if the reporter cite will be quoted to a client, verify 242 N.J. 449 against a reporter/opinion index rather than the slip PDF.

Friedman v. Martinez (A-37/81-18, decided June 16, 2020): intrusion occurs when a victim uses a private space where a spying device was concealed; no direct evidence of recording needed; circumstantial evidence and reasonable inferences suffice; victim must still show she used the monitored space; Appellate Division reversed and summary judgment reinstated
